summary: China Evergrande Group is ADVERSE due to being under formal liquidation since a Hong Kong court winding-up order on 29 January 2024, with liquidation ongoing as of 2026-10-01. No material adverse regulatory enforcement action was found in the evidence. The exact legal name and Hong Kong Companies Registry registration number remain undetermined.

findings.statement: China Evergrande Group was founded in 1996 in Guangzhou by Hui Ka Yan.
The head office of China Evergrande Group is located at No.78 Huangpu Avenue West, Tianhe District, Guangzhou, Guangdong Province, PRC, postal code 510620.
On 29 January 2024, the High Court of Hong Kong issued a winding-up order against China Evergrande Group, placing the company in liquidation.
As of 2026-10-01, China Evergrande Group is undergoing formal liquidation proceedings under Hong Kong law.
The evidence does not show any material adverse regulatory enforcement action, sanction, or major civil judgment against China Evergrande Group.
